sender_summary: Anke International is a 27-year-old Dubai-based custom display counter and refrigeration manufacturing company specializing in bespoke hospitality and food service equipment. With proven delivery for globally recognized brands like Tim Hortons and Caribou Coffee across the GCC, Anke designs and fabricates display counters, refrigeration units, and food service equipment tailored to the exact operational and brand standards of premium food & beverage groups. The team manages end-to-end project execution from consultation through custom fabrication to on-site installation.
receiver_summary: Ali Hashmi is a Senior Procurement Leader at Al Hatab, a food and beverage company operating in Saudi Arabia. As a senior procurement decision-maker, he is responsible for vendor evaluation, sourcing negotiations, supplier onboarding, and equipment purchasing decisions across the organization. He controls budgets and timelines for major equipment acquisitions including display counters, refrigeration units, and food service fixtures. His role bridges operational requirements and financial accountability, making him the key gatekeeper for any new supplier relationship. He operates in the KSA market and is likely managing procurement for multiple outlets or expansion projects.
outreach_goal: Introduce Anke International's custom commercial display counters as the ideal equipment solution for Al Hatab's F&B operations and secure a discovery conversation about current or upcoming procurement needs for display and refrigeration equipment
offer: Anke International designs and manufactures custom commercial display counters and refrigeration units built specifically for F&B brands — from QSR-style service counters to patisserie showcases, tea and beverage display stations, and specialty food service fixtures. With 27+ years of manufacturing experience and proven delivery for brands like Tim Hortons and Caribou Coffee in the GCC, we offer fully bespoke fabrication, competitive pricing, fast project timelines, and post-installation support. For F&B groups expanding or refreshing outlets across KSA, we deliver compliant, brand-aligned display solutions with GCC-based manufacturing proximity. Product details: https://ankeintl.com/display/

pain_points: Procurement leaders in KSA struggle to find reliable GCC-based manufacturers who can deliver custom display equipment on budget AND on schedule, Off-the-shelf display counters from international suppliers come with long lead times, high shipping costs, and no local support, Vetting new fabrication vendors for brand compliance and quality consistency is time-consuming for procurement teams managing multiple projects
tone: Professional and direct — from an experienced GCC manufacturer to a seasoned procurement professional, leading with cost-efficiency, reliability, and regional proximity advantages, consultative and straightforward without being salesy
